library(ggplot2)

# Exercise 1: Jump discontinuity in R

```{r}
resolution <- 0.1
xx <- seq(-1, 2, by = resolution)

# Three-piece function using boolean masking (same idea as NumPy)
piece1 <- sin(xx * pi)      * (xx < 0)
piece2 <- 1.5               * (abs(xx) < resolution / 2)
piece3 <- -(xx - 2)^2      * (xx > 0)

y <- piece1 + piece2 + piece3

# Tag each point with which piece it belongs to for color/shape
segment <- case_when(
  xx < 0              ~ "sin(x\u03c0)",
  abs(xx) < resolution / 2 ~ "1.5 (point)",
  xx > 0              ~ "-(x-2)\u00b2"
)

ggplot(data.frame(x = xx, y = y, seg = segment), aes(x, y, color = seg, shape = seg)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(x = "x", y = "y = f(x)", title = "A function with a jump discontinuity",
       color = NULL, shape = NULL)
```

# Exercise 2: Jump discontinuity — piecewise definition in R

In Python, `sympy.Piecewise()` defines the function symbolically.
In R, `ifelse()` (or `dplyr::case_when()`) is the natural equivalent.

```{r}
xx <- seq(-1, 2, by = 0.01)

fx <- case_when(
  xx < 0  ~ sin(xx * pi),
  xx == 0 ~ 1.5,
  xx > 0  ~ -(xx - 2)^2
)

ggplot(data.frame(x = xx, y = fx), aes(x, y)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "x", y = "y = f(x)", title = "Piecewise function (case_when)")
```

```{r}
# f(0) = 1.5 — evaluate the piecewise function at x = 0
x0 <- 0
val <- dplyr::case_when(x0 < 0 ~ sin(x0*pi), x0 == 0 ~ 1.5, x0 > 0 ~ -(x0-2)^2)
cat("f(0) =", val, "\n")
```

# Exercise 3: Removable discontinuity

```{r}
# f(x) = sin(x*pi) + x^2, but reassign f(0) to pi (point discontinuity)
resolution <- 0.1
xx <- seq(-1, 2, by = resolution)
fx <- sin(xx * pi) + xx^2

# Replace the value closest to x=0 with pi
fx[which.min(abs(xx - 0))] <- pi

ggplot(data.frame(x = xx, y = fx), aes(x, y)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(x = "x", y = "y = f(x)", title = "Removable discontinuity at x = 0")
```

# Exercise 4: Infinite discontinuity

```{r}
xx <- seq(-2, 2, length.out = 1001)
fx <- 3 / (1 - xx^2)

# Clip extreme values for plotting clarity
fx_plot <- ifelse(abs(fx) > 20, NA, fx)

ggplot(data.frame(x = xx, y = fx_plot), aes(x, y)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-20, 20)) +
  labs(x = "x", y = "y = f(x)", title = "Infinite discontinuity: f(x) = 3 / (1 - x\u00b2)")
```

```{r}
# Identify singularities (where denominator = 0)
# f(x) = 3/(1 - x^2) → singularities where 1 - x^2 = 0 → x = ±1
roots <- polyroot(c(1, 0, -1))   # roots of 1 - x^2 (coefficients of -x^2 + 1)
cat("Singularities at x =", Re(roots), "\n")

# Continuous domain within [-2, 2]: all x except ±1
cat("Continuous on (-2, -1) ∪ (-1, 1) ∪ (1, 2)\n")
```

# Exercise 5: Oscillating discontinuity

```{r}
xx <- seq(-1, 2, length.out = 101)
fx <- sin(1 / (xx - 1))

ggplot(data.frame(x = xx, y = fx), aes(x, y)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "x", y = "y = f(x)", title = "Oscillating discontinuity: sin(1/(x-1))")
```
